feature_name: Fix Uint8Array serialization in nested JSON fields
description: Update the parameterization logic to properly serialize Uint8Array values when they appear nested within objects or arrays in Json fields. Currently, nested Uint8Array values are incorrectly serialized as numeric-keyed objects instead of base64 strings, which breaks round-trip data consistency.
functional_requirements: Replace JSON.stringify with safeJsonStringify in the parameterization module to handle ArrayBuffer.isView values
Ensure Uint8Array values nested inside objects are serialized as base64 strings when stored in Json fields
Ensure Uint8Array values nested inside arrays are serialized as base64 strings when stored in Json fields
Maintain existing correct behavior for top-level Uint8Array values (already working)
Handle deeply nested Uint8Array values consistently throughout the serialization process
